title: Lanes
logline: The first true silent Sunday. The neon with the L out. The glow on the ridge.

margin.note: A gull, and a dog beside it — the only time while the dog lives.

panels.composition: Tier 1: SMALL WOOD LANES from across the highway at night. Its neon — the L flickering out — hammered by rain and doubled in the wet asphalt. One car in the lot.
props: neon sign SMALL WOOD LANES with a dead L

image.prompt: a bowling alley across a two-lane highway at night, its neon sign with one dead letter reflected in rain-hammered wet asphalt, one car in the lot, wet-on-wet watercolor, bruised indigo sky
image.notes: The sign text may be lettered by the generator: SMALL WOOD LANES with the first L dark. If it garbles, letter it after.

panels.name: The sign

panels.composition: Tier 2: closer. The dumpster behind the alley, chained. On the chain-link, a wet ring of rope where a leash was tied once. Nothing else.

image.prompt: a rusted dumpster behind a building at night, chained, a small wet loop of rope tied to the chain-link fence, rain, watercolor, muted

panels.name: The rope

panels.composition: Tier 3: wide again, later. The neon off. The lot empty. On the ridge east of town, far and small, a glow that is not the moon and that the composition treats as weather.
props: a faint glow on the forested ridge

image.prompt: the same bowling alley later with its neon off and the lot empty, and far on the forested ridge behind the town a faint pale glow that is not the moon, treated like weather, wet-on-wet watercolor

panels.name: The ridge

notes: No words. The glow on the ridge appears here first and is never asked about.
